name: Weight Converter
summary: Convert weight and mass between grams, kilograms, pounds, ounces, and more — locally.
description: Type a mass value and instantly convert across milligrams, grams, kilograms, metric tons, ounces, pounds, and stones. Everything runs in your browser.

faqs.question: Weight or mass?
faqs.answer: These are mass units under standard gravity (everyday “weight” conversion).

faqs.question: Which units are included?
faqs.answer: mg, g, kg, metric ton, ounce, pound, and stone.
